author: fwyzard
body:
Use Nlohmann json from cmsdist: ORT requires 3.11.3+, and cmsdist provides 3.12.0.

Always use the bundled version of flatbuffers, 23.5.26, because the .fbs.h headers require exactly that version.

Explicitly disable telemetry.

Explicitly disable FP4 QMoE CUDA kernels, as they are not used in CMSSW and expensive to build.
title: ONNXRuntime: update to version 1.30.0
